def add_elevation(self, delta: float) -> None:
    """
    Adjusts elevation data of GPX data.

    Parameters
    ----------
    delta : float
        Elevation delta in meters to apply to GPX data
    """
    for track in self.tracks:
        track.add_elevation(delta)
